mechanism: Lisdexamfetamine (sympathomimetic) may potentiate cardiovascular effects of prednisolone and increase risk of hyperglycemia, hypertension, and psychiatric effects; prednisolone may mask appetite suppression from amphetamine.
action: Monitor blood pressure, heart rate, blood glucose, and psychiatric symptoms; consider alternative ADHD medication if corticosteroid use is prolonged; ensure appropriate dosing and regular clinical assessment.
